title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Learn Air NZ tips, baggage rules, and seat selection to make family travel easier
intro: As a parent, flying domestic in NZ can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to managing kids on a flight. With Air NZ's complex baggage allowance and seat selection rules, it's essential to be prepared before your next family trip. From Queenstown to Christchurch and Wellington, we've got you covered with our expert tips and insights

sections.heading: Air NZ Domestic Flights with Kids
sections.body: When flying with kids on Air NZ domestic flights, it's crucial to choose the right seats to ensure a comfortable journey. Air NZ offers a variety of seat options, including Economy, Premium Economy, and Business Class. For families, the Economy class is the most budget-friendly option, with prices starting from $99 NZD one-way from Auckland to Wellington.

sections.heading: Family Seating on Air NZ
list: Book seats together: Ensure you book seats together to keep your family close and make the flight more enjoyable
Choose seats near the front: Seats near the front of the plane tend to be less noisy and have less turbulence
Consider upgrading: If budget allows, consider upgrading to Premium Economy for extra legroom and comfort

sections.heading: Baggage Allowance on Air NZ Domestic Flights
sections.body: Air NZ has a strict baggage allowance policy, with checked baggage starting from $20 NZD per bag. It's essential to pack light and avoid unnecessary baggage fees. For families, it's recommended to pack essentials like nappies, formula, and baby food in your carry-on luggage to avoid any issues during the flight.

sections.heading: Comparison of Air NZ Domestic Routes
Drive Times and Alternative Options
sections.body: If you're not keen on flying, consider driving to your destination. From Auckland to Wellington, the drive time is around 8-9 hours, while Auckland to Christchurch takes around 12-13 hours. However, with the cost of fuel and accommodation, flying might still be the more budget-friendly option. You can use our NZ Family Travel Budget Calculator to compare costs and make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Popular Family Destinations in NZ
list: Queenstown: Known for its stunning scenery and outdoor activities like skiing and hiking
Christchurch: A great destination for families, with attractions like the Christchurch Botanic Gardens and the Canterbury Museum
Wellington: The capital city offers a range of family-friendly activities, including the Te Papa Museum and the Wellington Zoo

sections.heading: Plan Your Next Family Adventure
sections.body: With these tips and insights, you're ready to plan your next family adventure in NZ. Whether you're flying or driving, make sure to book your accommodations in advance to avoid any last-minute hassles. Check out our destinations page for more information on popular family-friendly spots in NZ.
